_what: The `measured` block 50 Upgrades needs from EQLSGapEngine. HAND-WRITTEN by Session B, not generated from any engine output — it states what B needs, so E makes it pass rather than B describing what E already does.
_why: Every one of these is a value the engine already computes and then discards. This is not a request for new modelling; it is a request to stop throwing away.
_never: B does not ask for a rate, a ceiling, or any modelled absolute. Those are E's and they stay E's. B needs measured quantities it can divide by and attribute against.
_whyNotVersionedInTheFilename: It was `gap-contract-1.2.0.json` until 1 Sep 2026, and it went stale the moment the pin moved — a name that must be renamed by hand is a name that will be wrong. The version it is asserted against now lives in `assertedEngineVersion` below, and `gapEngine.test.ts` fails if that field and `REQUIRED_ENGINE_VERSION` ever disagree. Renaming was a published-path change and is called out in the commit that made it.
_versionAssertion: A consumer asserts EQLSGapEngine.version === assertedEngineVersion EXACTLY before reading any key below — a newer engine is refused as readily as an older one. On any other value it must emit its unknown band and ship anyway: B is never blocked on E and E is never blocked on B.
_thisFixtureIsLoaded: gapEngine.test.ts feeds the `measured` block below through the real gapAvailability(). Between 31 Aug and 1 Sep nothing loaded this file at all, so it was a document claiming to be a check. It is now a check.

measured._engaged_seconds: int, seconds. The denominator for anything expressed per second of combat.
measured._melee_seconds: int, seconds, and DELIBERATELY DISTINCT from engaged_seconds. E's own report already notes 222s in melee against 218s engaged; a consumer that divides by the wrong one is wrong by ~2% silently. Both are needed precisely because they differ.
measured._damage_dealt: int, outgoing damage INSIDE THE ENGAGED WINDOW ONLY. Until 1.3.0 this fixture called it 'the denominator for share-of-output' and that was WRONG — spells_landed is counted over every line in the log, so the division crosses a population boundary. E measured it: 202% on the log the engine was built against, 324% on a short one, 34% and 0% on two others, so the error is not even a constant a reader could learn to subtract. The sound denominator is window.all_lines.damage. B's `shareOfOutput()` is the only supported way to take the ratio.
measured._months_seen: int, distinct calendar months the log covers. Not a duration — a staleness signal. A recommendation built on a log from three months ago is a different claim from one built on last night, and the reader is entitled to know which.

window._added: 1.3.0, and the reason B re-pinned rather than staying put. Three populations were always in this block; until now it did not say so.
window._all_lines: THE share denominator. Every line in the log, which is the population spells_landed and resists were always counted over.
window._keys_by_population: B asserts only the two filings it depends on — damage_dealt under in_window, spells_landed under all_lines — against the REAL bundle, in POPULATION_OF. If E re-files either, that test fails and a human re-reads this contract instead of quietly dividing one population by another.

spells_landed._shape: Keyed by the RAW log string, verbatim, because that is the only key a consumer can join back to a log line it is showing a player. The normalised name is a VALUE, never the key — normalisation is lossy and B must be able to see what was actually written.

Cannibalization I._worked_entry: The rank suffix is stripped and the family name normalised: 'Cannibalization I' -> 'Cannibalize'. Both must survive: the raw string joins to the log, the normalised key joins to a catalogue. A zero damage_total here is a real measurement — Cannibalize costs health and deals none — and is not the same as 'not recorded'.
Cannibalization I._zero_is_not_missing: A spell that landed 47 times with 0 damage is measured. A spell absent from this object entirely is unmeasured. A consumer must not read the first as the second, and must not read a landings count of 0 as evidence a spell is unused — a count of zero is indistinguishable from a vocabulary miss and routes to the unknown band.

Shadow Vortex._why_median: B takes magnitude from damage_median, never from a catalogue figure and never from damage_total/landings. The median is robust to a partial resist or a crit at the tail, and it sidesteps the ceiling formula entirely.

_bounds_this_fixture_does_not_relax: Never invent a number. A key absent from `measured` is unmeasured and must reach the reader as unknown, never as zero.
Never divide across a population. A share is only a share against the population its numerator came from.
Nothing here promises anything about loot. The LOOT lockout is not observable from a log.
B does not rank. This block feeds E's ranking; B supplies candidates and deltas.
